rules.title: 📘 Rules of Play
rules.mergeDesc: Drag two identical items of the same tier together to merge them into a higher tier. Different items can be swapped.
rules.generateDesc: Using the Supply Station consumes Stamina; it requires a short break after continuous use. Stamina also recovers offline.
rules.ordersDesc: Listen to the villager's request first. After replying "I'll help you," the quest will begin. Deliver all materials to hear more from the character.
rules.boardDesc: Spend Coins to melt snow-locked tiles. Tap Frost Bubbles to pop them, and open Treasure Chests when their timers end.
rules.storyDesc: Open "Main Quest" on the task shelf or enter the "Valley" to play 6 chapters and 24 story scenes in order. Awaken the Frostheart and bring back spring; your journal will keep the memories you make with the valley's people.
